title: AST/ALT ratio does not improve held-cohort HbA1c classification beyond separate enzymes and metabolic risk factors
abstract: We tested whether a source-winsorized AST/ALT ratio improves classification of single-visit HbA1c>=6.5% beyond demographics, BMI, waist, blood pressure and log AST/ALT. NHANES2007-08 supplied 5057 adults (562 cases); separately sampled2009-10 supplied 5399 (572 cases). Fivefold source out-of-fold deltaAUC was-0.000817. Frozen target AUC was0.819969 versus0.818677, delta-0.001292 (paired95%CI[-0.002055,-0.000564]). Joint refit uncertainty included zero. Standard glucose and flexible-enzyme challenges did not reveal a gain. This is a bounded negative test of representation, not evidence against liver-metabolic biology or a study of incident diabetes.
